name: (Martial Artist, Dirty Fighting) Contraband Substance
text: The martial artist pulls out a concealed alchemical vial of mutagen and drinks it to improve their combat prowess. The item is usually a Juggernaut Mutagen (Lesser), or Quicksilver Mutagen (Lesser). This ability can't be used again until the martial artist has time to acquire and hide a new mutagen. Some martial artists use concealed small vials, but others hide a syringe or soak the alchemical liquid into a garment they can put in their mouth.
